activity.notes: Heo Jun's representative scholarly-medical Activity is the compilation of Donguibogam: the project was ordered in 1596 and the work was completed in 1610. ATLAS does not stretch this Activity across his whole lifetime.

sources.title: 허준
sources.citation_text: The Encyclopedia of Korean Culture identifies Heo Jun as the principal physician associated with the compilation of Donguibogam.

sources.title: 동의보감
